Copy-Item $jsonlFile.FullName $rrlPath -Force\n    Write-Host \"  COPIED: $rrlPath\"\n}\n\n$rrlText   = Get-Content $rrlPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8\n$rrlBytes  = (Get-Item $rrlPath).Length\n$rrlChars  = $rrlText.Length\n\n# FIDELITY GATE: verify RRL contains both speakers\n$hasUser      = $rrlText -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"user\"'\n$hasAssistant = $rrlText -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"assistant\"'\nif \"RRL SIZE WARN: $rrlBytes bytes (< 50KB) — expected full transcript. Check JSONL source.\"\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 1 ✓ RRL: $rrlPath — $rrlBytes bytes ($rrlChars chars)\"\n```\n\n**RRL is the ONLY hard stop. No JSONL source = exit 1. No RRL = no run = exit 1.**\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 2 — SOUL (ATOMIC RECEIPT)\n\nQuery ONCE before POST. POST. Query ONCE after. Store receipt. Never re-query.\nSource: user turns extracted from the RRL (not a separate hand-written file).\n\n```powershell\n$countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n\n# Post Michael's verbatim words from the RRL to soul-logger\n# SOUL = user turns only. \"\"\n$inAssistantBlock = $false\n\nforeach ($line in $lines) {\n    $trimmed = $line.Trim()\n    \n    # Detect role markers (JSONL format)\n    if ($trimmed -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"') {\n        # Save previous block if it was assistant\n        if ($inAssistantBlock -and $currentBlock.Trim().Length -gt 10) {\n            $turnSeq++\n            $text = $currentBlock.Trim()\n            run    = $run\n                seq    = $turnSeq\n                type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n                chars  = $text.Length\n                text   = $text\n            }\n        }\n        $currentRole = $matches[1]\n        $currentBlock = \"\"\n        $inAssistantBlock = ($currentRole -eq \"assistant\")\n    }\n    # Detect plain-text speaker markers\n    elseif ($trimmed -match '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]') {\n        if ($inAssistantBlock -and $currentBlock.Trim().Length -gt 10) {\n            $turnSeq++\n       $dnaRecords += [ordered]@{\n                run    = $run\n                seq    = $turnSeq\n                type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n                chars  = $text.Length\n                text   = $text\n            }\n        }\n        $inAssistantBlock = $true\n        $currentBlock = $trimmed -replace '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]\\s*', ''\n    }\n    # Accumulate lines within a block\n    elseif ($inAssistantBlock) {\n        $currentBlock += \"`n$line\"\n    }\n}\n\n# Flush final block\nif ($inAssistantBlock -and $currentBlock.Trim().Length -gt 10) {\n    $turnSeq++\n    $text = $currentBlock.Trim()\n    $isBlueprint = ($text -match '```|`````|fenced code block|\\b(SPEC|SPECIFICATION|BLUEPRINT|ARCHITECTURE|SCHEMA|DESIGN)\\b' -and $text.Length -gt 200)\n    $dnaRecords += [ordered]@{\n        run    = $run\n        seq    = $turnSeq\n        type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n        chars  = $text.Length\n        text   = $text\n    }\n}\n\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n# EC-026: DUAL-HASH DETERMINISM NORMALIZATION\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n# DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED:\n#   JSONL path (line ~190): role-marker line (\"role\":\"assistant\") is EXCLUDED from $currentBlock\n#   Plain-text path (line ~209): speaker-marker line (\"AGENT:\") is INCLUDED with prefix stripped\n#   Result: same semantic turn produces different character counts depending on which parser path was taken.\n# FIX: Normalize both paths — strip role-marker and speaker-prefix lines to empty before accumulation.\n#   After normalization, both paths should produce identical byte counts for the same semantic content.\n$dnaTotalCharsJsonl  = 0\n$dnaTotalCharsPlain  = 0\n$dnaJsonlRecords     = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.text -notmatch '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]' }).Count\n$dnaPlainRecords     = $dnaRecords.Count - $dnaJsonlRecords\nif ($dnaJsonlRecords -gt 0 -and $dnaPlainRecords -gt 0) {\n    $dnaTotalCharsJsonl = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.text -notmatch '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]' } | Measure-Object -Property chars -Sum).Sum\n    $dnaTotalCharsPlain = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.text -match '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]' } | Measure-Object -Property chars -Sum).Sum\n}\nif ($dnaTotalCharsJsonl -gt 0 -and $dnaTotalCharsPlain -gt 0) {\n    $charDiff = [Math]::Abs($dnaTotalCharsJsonl - $dnaTotalCharsPlain)\n    $avgChars = ($dnaTotalCharsJsonl + $dnaTotalCharsPlain) / 2\n    if ($avgChars -gt 0) {\n        $pctDiff = ($charDiff / $avgChars) * 100\n        if ($pctDiff -gt 1.0) {\n            Write-Warning \"EC-026 DUAL-HASH DRIFT: JSONL-path chars=$dnaTotalCharsJsonl vs plain-path chars=$dnaTotalCharsPlain — diff $pctDiff% (>1%). DNA hash may not be deterministic across parser paths.\"\n        } else {\n            Write-Host \"  EC-026 OK: JSONL/plain char diff = $pctDiff% (within 1% tolerance)\"\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n$dnaCount = $dnaRecords.Count\n$dnaBlueprintCount = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" }).Count\n\nif ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n    $dnaPath = \"$dnaDir\\dna-run$run.json\"\n    $dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $dnaPath -Encoding UTF8\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ✓ DNA: $dnaCount records ($dnaBlueprintCount blueprints) → $dnaPath\"\n} else {\n    Write-Warning \"STAGE 3 ⚠ DNA_GAP — 0 assistant turns extracted from RRL\"\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n\n```powershell\n# --- Helper Functions ---\nfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        ForEach-Object { if ($_.Name -match 'HL-(\\d+)\\.json$') { [int]$matches[1] } }\n    if ($existing) { return ($existing | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum + 1 }\n    return 1\n}\nfunction Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n    if (-not $latest) { return $null }\n    $entry = Get-Content $latest.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\n    return $entry.merkle_hash\n}\nfunction Compute-Sha256 {\n    param([string]$InputString)\n    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n}\n\nif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n$parentHash = [ordered]@{\n    hl_id          = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n    session_id     = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n    rrl_source     = $rrlPath\n    char_count     = $rrlChars\n    byte_count     = $rrlBytes\n $timestamp\n    sov100         = $true\n    run            = $run\n}\n\n$ledgerPath = \"$ledgerDir\\HL-$nextHL.json\"\n$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 5 — STARMAP ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"prose\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"turn-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n} else { \"\" }\n\n$dnaTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n SOULKEYS (KEYWORD INDEX — SOUL + DNA, READ-MERGE-WRITE)\n\nExtract keywords over BOTH SOUL (user words) AND DNA (agent blueprints).\nNever `-Append` on JSON. Always read → merge in memory → overwrite.\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $keywordDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $keywordDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# Extract terms from both SOUL Any HOLLOW stage = GAP.\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 8 — REGISTRY SYNC (ART ARSENAL × SOULKEYS × STARMAP × LEDGER)\n\nCross-references this run's SOULKEYS against the art-arsenal registry.\nAny piece whose tags intersect the run's top keywords gets tagged with the run, HL ID, starmap pointer, and merkle hash.\nWrites a canonical artifact. ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n248\t# EC-026: DUAL-HASH DETERMINISM NORMALIZATION\n249\t# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n250\t# DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED:\n251\t#   JSONL path STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n292\t\n293\t```powershell\n294\t# --- Helper Functions ---\n295\tfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n296\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n297\t return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n315\t}\n316\t\n317\tif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null { \"DNA_GAP\" }\n327\t\n328\t$ledgerHash = Compute-Sha256 \"$soulHash|$dnaHash|$parentHash|$timestamp\"\n329\t\n330\t$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{\n331\t    hl_id          = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n332\t Copy-Item $jsonlFile.FullName $rrlPath -Force\n93\t    Write-Host \"  COPIED: $rrlPath\"\n94\t}\n95\t\n96\t$rrlText   = Get-Content $rrlPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8\n97\t$rrlBytes  = (Get-Item Get-Next-LedgerID {\n232\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n233\t    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n234\t        ForEach-Object { Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n239\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n240\t    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n241\t    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath One run = one HL.\"\n261\t    exit 1\n262\t}\n263\t\n264\t$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n265\t$parentHash = Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n266\t\n267\t$timestamp = | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\n293\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n294\t```\n295\t\n296\t---\n297\t\n298\t## STAGE 5 — STARMAP (POINTER MAP — ANTI-BLOAT)\n299\t\n300\t```powershell\n301\tif (-not (Test-Path $starmapDir)) { Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n183\t\n184\t**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n185\t\n186\tAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n187\t\n188\t### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n189\t\n190\t`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n191\t\n192\t**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n193\t\n194\t### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n195\t\n196\t`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n197\t\n198\t**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n199\t\n200\t### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n201\t\n202\tPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n203\t\n204\t**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n205\t\n206\t### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n207\t\n208\tWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n224\t\n225\t**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n226\t\n227\tVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n228\t\n229\t### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n230\t\n231\tWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n652\t\n653\t### Fix Applied\n654\t**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n655\t1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n656\t2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n657\t3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n658\t\n659\t### What Was NOT Changed\n660\t- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n661\t- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n662\t- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n663\t- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n664\t\n665\t### Testing\n666\t- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n667\t- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n668\t- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n669\t- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n670\t\n671\t### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\n672\tAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n673\t\n674\t1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n675\t2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n676\t3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n677\t\n678\t### Remaining Known Issues\n679\t- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n680\t- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n681\t- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n682\t- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n683\t\n684\t---\n685\t\n686\t## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n687\t\n688\t### Overview\n689\tRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n690\t\n691\t---\n692\t\n693\t### 1. Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n\n**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n\nAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n\n### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n\n`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n\n**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n\n### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n\n`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n\n**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n\n### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n\nPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n\n**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n\nWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Deepgram's in-house LLM responds via `ConversationText` event in ~200-500ms.\n\n- `agentTextResolve` promise pattern: `reactLLM()` sets resolver, `handleAgentMsg` resolves it on assistant `ConversationText`\n- 6-second timeout → falls back to REST if agent doesn't respond\n\n### Voice-First UI: magic-chat.html\n\nApp is a speaking trainer — text input removed from visible UI.\n- `#msg` input and `#sendBtn` hidden via CSS (`display: none`) — kept in DOM so JS refs don't break\n- `#mic` button made large (72×72px), centered, prominent\n- `#micStatus` text element added below mic button — shows: \"Tap to start\" / \"Connecting…\" / \"Listening…\" / \"Processing…\"\n- `#mic.mic-active` pulsing purple animation (existing)\n\n### Auto-mic: gesture-time stream acquisition\n\nBrowser security requires `getUserMedia()` to be called inside a user gesture event. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n\n**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n\nVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. Correct: `https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`. This caused slow/failed connections. Always use the full path.\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong text injection event name (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe sent `{type: \"TextInput\", text: \"...\"}` — **does not exist** in Deepgram API. Correct: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}`. Verified from official docs.\n\n### Root Cause: BYO DeepSeek LLM caused unnecessary external hop\n\nWe used `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `endpoint.url: deepseek.com` + `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. This routes through an external API (China-hosted, variable latency).\n\n**Fix**: Deepgram manages OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA models natively — **no API key needed**. Just set `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` with `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` and NO `endpoint` field. Deepgram handles the LLM call on their own infrastructure. Remove all external LLM endpoints from the Voice Agent settings.\n\n### Root Cause: openVoiceAgent() called too late in boot (15-second startup)\n\n`openVoiceAgent()` was called at the END of boot() after 5 serial awaits. Voice Agent connection didn't start until 5+ seconds into page load.\n\n**Fix**: Call `openVoiceAgent()` immediately after `urlStudentId` is extracted (first thing in boot). Also parallelized all 4 boot API calls (state + memory + vocab + hint) with `Promise.allSettled`.\n\n### Root Cause: /api/agent blocked 101 response on Deepgram connection\n\nThe CF Worker was `await fetch(\"agent.deepgram.com\")` BEFORE returning the 101 WebSocket upgrade. Browser was stuck waiting for the Deepgram TCP handshake.\n\n**Fix**: Return 101 to browser immediately, connect to Deepgram via `ctx.waitUntil()` in background. Queue any early browser messages until Deepgram is ready.\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Confirmed Correct Spec (READ BEFORE TOUCHING AGENT CODE)\n\n- **WS URL**: `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` (NOT just `/`)\n- **Auth**: `Authorization: Token {DEEPGRAM_API_KEY}` header on the WS upgrade fetch\n- **Settings**: sent after receiving `Welcome` event from server\n- **User text injection**: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}` (NOT TextInput)\n- **Agent speech injection**: `{type: \"InjectAgentMessage\", content: \"...\"}`\n- **Managed LLMs (no key)**: `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` with NO `endpoint` — Deepgram pays for it\n- **Managed LLMs available**: OpenAI, Anthropic (`claude-4-5-haiku-latest`), Google (`gemini-2.5-flash`), NVIDIA\n- **BYO LLMs require key**: Groq, AWS Bedrock — need your own endpoint + credentials\n- **STT model**: `nova-3` (or `flux-general-en` for newer)\n- **TTS model**: `aura-2-asteria-en`\n- **Client sends audio**: binary PCM16 frames directly over WS\n- **Server events**: `Welcome`, `SettingsApplied`, `ConversationText` (role: user|assistant), `AgentAudioDone`, FIX — GAPLESS PLAYBACK v2 (2026-05-31)\n\n### Problem\nVoice agent audio was choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n\n### Fix Applied\n**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n\n### What Was NOT Changed\n- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n\n### Testing\n- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n\n### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\nAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n\n1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n\n### Remaining Known Issues\n- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n\n---\n\n## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n\n### Overview\nRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n\n---\n\n### 1. confidence user finished → send to LLM\n- `EagerEndOfTurn` — Medium confidence → prepare LLM response early (lower latency)\n- `TurnResumed` — User continued speaking → cancel prepared response\n- `StartOfTurn` — User started speaking → interrupt agent if playing\n\n**Two Voice Agent Patterns:**\n1. **EndOfTurn Only** (recommended start): Simpler, fewer LLM calls, higher latency\n2. **EagerEndOfTurn + EndOfTurn**: Lower latency, more LLM calls, needs TurnResumed handling\n\n**Tuning Parameters:** `eot_threshold`, `eager_eot_threshold`, `eot_timeout_ms` — adjustable mid-stream via Voice Agent API (managed pipeline). Flux would require building custom STT→LLM→TTS pipeline instead of using managed Voice Agent. NOT recommended for current architecture unless latency becomes critical issue. Handlers Implemented\n| Event | Handler | Status |\n|-------|---------|--------|\n| Welcome | Send Settings + history | ✓ |\n| SettingsApplied | Reset state, start keepalive, send greeting | ✓ |\n| bubble, increment turns | ✓ |\n| AgentAudioDone | Flush accumulator, start silence timer on drain | ✓ |\n| FunctionCallRequest | Save vocab, send response, inject confirmation | ✓ |\n| Goodbye | End session, show Tiger Win | ✓ |\n| Error | Log, force close, trigger reconnect | ✓ |\n| Warning | Console warn only | ✓ |\n\n### 4.4 Timers and Intervals\n| Timer | Interval | Purpose |\n|-------|----------|--------|\n| KeepAlive | 3500ms | Prevent WS timeout |\n| AudioFocus watchdog | 3000ms | Resume suspended AudioContext (Android) |\n| Silence nudge | 6000ms after AgentAudioDone + queue drain | Prompt silent student |\n| Nudge cooldown | 15000ms between nudges | Prevent nudge loop |\n| Reconnect backoff | 2000ms × 1.5^n, max 15000ms | Exponential backoff on drop |\n| Max retries | 5 | Cap infinite retry loops |\n\n### 4.5 Known Vulnerabilities in Our Code\n1. **InjectAgentMessage uses `message` field** — may need `content` (EC-5)\n2. **No inject watchdog** — silent + DNA)\n\n```powershell\n# --- Helper Functions ---\nfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" }\n    return 1\n}\nfunction Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ N=[int]([regex]::Match($_.Name,'HL-(\\d+)').Groups[1].Value); F=$_.FullName }    param([string]$InputString)\n    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n}\n\nif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# Idempotency: abort if this run Never re-query.\n185\tSource: user turns extracted from the RRL (not a separate hand-written file).\n186\t\n187\t```powershell\n188\tif ($kiloSession) {\n189\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — SOUL POST skipped (no real transcript)\"\n190\t    $countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n191\t    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"DRYRUN\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"KILO_HOLLOW\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n192\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: DRYRUN | soulcount=$countBefore (unchanged)\"\n193\t} else {\n194\t\n195\t$countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n196\t\n197\t# Extract user turns — Claude Code JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role, content at $obj.message.content[].text\n198\t$userTexts = $rrlText -split \"`n\" | ForEach-Object {\n199\t    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n200\t    if (-not $o) { return }\n201\t    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n202\t    if ($role -ne 'user') { return }\n203\t    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n204\t    if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n205\t    elseif ($content -is [array]) { ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\" }\n206\t} | Where-Object { $_ }\n207\t$soulText  = ($userTexts -join \"`n\").Trim()\n208\t\n209\t# Contamination guard: abort if soul payload ≈ full RRL (extraction failure → raw transcript)\n210\t$soulBytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($soulText)\n211\tif ($soulBytes -ge ($rrlBytes * 0.95)) {\n212\t    Write-Error \"STAGE 2 ABORT — soul ($soulBytes bytes) ~= RRL ($rrlBytes bytes). Raw-transcript contamination. Fix extractor.\"\n213\t    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP_CONTAMINATION_GUARD\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n214\t} elseif (-not $soulText) {\n215\t    Write-Warning \"STAGE 2 SOUL_GAP — 0 user turns extracted.\"\n216\t    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n217\t} else {\n218\t    $soulBody = @{\n219\t        student_id = \"sov100-michael\"\n220\t        session_id = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n221\t        role       = \"user\"\n222\t        text       = $soulText\n223\t    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 2 -Compress\n224\t\n225\t    $soulPost   = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"$D1/api/soul/event\" -Method Post `\n226\t        -Body $soulBody -ContentType \"application/json\"\n227\t    $countAfter = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n228\t\n229\t    $receipt = [ordered]@{\n230\t        event_id     = $soulPost.event_id\n231\t        count_before = $countBefore\n232\t        count_after  = $countAfter\n233\t        delta        = $countAfter - $countBefore\n234\t        level        = $countAfter\n235\t        posted_at    = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n236\t    }\n237\t}\n238\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: event_id=$($receipt.event_id) | Δ$($receipt.delta) | $($receipt.count_after) chars\"\n239\t} # end else ($kiloSession)\n240\t```\n241\t\n242\t**$receipt.count_after is the SOLE soulcount source for seal §3, §12, pipeline JSON, commit message, BOOT.**\n243\t\n244\t---\n245\t\n246\t## STAGE 3 — DNA (ASSISTANT TURN EXTRACTION — YOUR WORDS + BLUEPRINTS)\n247\t\n248\t**OLD BEHAVIOR (BROKEN):** Probed D1 endpoint for prompts that were never stored. Returned 0. DNA was dead.\n249\t**NEW BEHAVIOR:** Extract assistant/agent turns from the RRL file. Tag each block. Write to CANON/SOUL/EXTRACT/dna-run{N}.json.\n250\t\n251\tDNA = the agent's words from this run, especially high-token-cost blueprints (fenced code blocks, structured specs, architecture -Force | Out-Null }\n256\t\n257\t$dnaCount = 0; $dnaBlueprintCount = 0; $dnaRecords = @()\n258\t\n259\tif ($kiloSession) {\n260\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — DNA extraction skipped (no $obj.message.role\n267\t# Walk content[].type=='text' only — explicitly skip 'thinking' blocks\n268\t$lines | ForEach-Object {\n269\t    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n295\t    $dnaPath = \"$dnaDir\\dna-run$run.json\"\n296\t    $dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $dnaPath -Encoding UTF8\n297\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ✓ DNA: ($kiloSession)\n303\t```\n304\t\n305\t---\n306\t\n307\t## STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n308\t\n309\t```powershell\n310\t# --- Helper Functions ---\n311\tfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n312\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n313\t    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n314\t        ForEach-Object { Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n319\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n320\t    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n321\t    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n322\t        ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ N=[int]([regex]::Match($_.Name,'HL-(\\d+)').Groups[1].Value); F=$_.FullName } } |\n323\t        Sort-Object N -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n324\t    if (-not $latest) { return $null }\n325\t    (Get-Content $latest.F -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).merkle_hash\n326\t}\n327\tfunction Compute-Sha256 {\n328\t    param([string]$InputString)\n329\t    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n330\t    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n331\t    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n332\t}\n333\t\n334\tif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n335\t\n336\t# Idempotency: abort if this run already has a sealed HL\n337\t$dupe = Get-ChildItem $ledgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n338\t    Where-Object { try { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).run -eq $run } catch { $false } }\n339\tif ($dupe) {\n340\t    Write-Error \"IDEMPOTENCY ABORT — run $run already sealed as $($dupe.Name). One run = one HL.\"\n341\t    exit 1\n342\t}\n343\t\n344\t$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n345\t$parentHash = Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n346\t\n347\t$timestamp = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n348\t\n349\t# Dual hash: soul_hash (user words) + dna_hash (agent words)\n350\t$soulHash = Compute-Sha256 $rrlText\n351\t$dnaHash  = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { Compute-Sha256 ($dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) } else { \"DNA_GAP\" }\n352\t\n353\t$ledgerHash = Compute-Sha256 \"$soulHash|$dnaHash|$parentHash|$timestamp\"\n354\t\n355\t$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{\n356\t $ledgerHash\n366\t    sealed_at      = $timestamp\n367\t    sov100         = $true\n368\t    run            = $run\n369\t}\n370\t\n371\t$ledgerPath = \"$ledgerDir\\HL-$nextHL.json\"\n372\t$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\n373\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n374\t```\n375\t\n376\t---\n377\t\n378\t## STAGE 5 — STARMAP (POINTER MAP — ANTI-BLOAT)\n379\t\n380\t```powershell\n381\tif (-not (Test-Path $starmapDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $starmapDir -Force | Out-Null }\n382\t\n383\t$soulTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { \n384\t    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"prose\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"turn-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n385\t} else { \"\" }\n386\t\n387\t$dnaTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n388\t    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" -Depth 4\n406\t\n407\t$starmapPath = \"$starmapDir\\starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n408\t$starmap | Set-Content $starmapPath -Encoding UTF8\n409\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 5 ✓ STARMAP: $starmapPath (pointer map, }\n430\t$wordFreq = $words | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 30\n431\t\n432\t$rfkwPath = \"$keywordDir\\rfkw-run$runPad.txt\"\n433\t$wordFreq | ForEach-Object {
